conviction_note: Q3 deliveries (196 vs 201) and the direction of Q3 profitability were both pre-released, at the 2026-10-14 pre-close call and in the monthly delivery data. The sell-side has already cut Q3 EBIT adj to about -7% YoY (Bloomberg consensus EUR 1.79bn), and management has reaffirmed ~870 deliveries with every Q4 aircraft already in final assembly. So the release most likely reiterates guidance and lands against a bar the company lowered itself. I found nothing company-level and unpriced: the findings net to +0.1, and p_up 52 x abs 3.5 gives +0.14. The two measurements agree that this is close to a non-result.

already_public.what: Q3 2026 commercial deliveries 196 (vs 201 Q3 2025; 547 YTD vs 507), September 72

Pre-close call: Q3 commercial profitability hit by fixed-cost under-absorption (mainly widebodies) and quality topics, higher FY R&D, a negative impact from the Spirit AeroSystems work packages, helicopters on a weaker mix, D&S growing more slowly; cash in line with seasonality, inventories high; 870 target reaffirmed; results 28 Oct after the close
FY2026 guide reiterated at H1: ~870 deliveries, EBIT adj ~EUR 7.5bn, FCF before customer financing ~EUR 4.5bn; H1 EBIT adj EUR 2.727bn, H1 FCF -EUR 1.166bn
EUR 5bn three-year buyback announced at the 21 July CMD (2029 EBIT adj target EUR 12-13bn); a separate employee-plan buyback of up to 4.1m shares ran 11 Sep to 6 Nov

new_in_release.expect: Q3 EBIT adj against the Bloomberg consensus of EUR 1.79bn (-7% YoY); a slight beat is more likely than a miss, given that the pre-close lowered the bar and Airbus beat EPS consensus in 3 of its last 4 quarters

~870 deliveries, EUR 7.5bn EBIT adj and EUR 4.5bn FCF most likely reiterated (UBS expects this; in 2025 Airbus cut deliveries only in late December). A delivery cut is the tail, and UBS expects EBIT to be held even then
9M FCF before customer financing likely still negative on high widebody inventory, leaving a very large Q4 implied to reach the EUR 4.5bn guide. Mildly negative risk
possible A350 rate-increase decision (Wagner: 'prochainement'), which would be positive; A330 quality policy to EASA due mid-November, outside the window

DZ Bank expected +4% (https://www.boursedirect.fr/fr/actualites/categorie/analyse-des-valeurs-qui-font-l-actualite/airbus-confirme-ses-objectifs-de-livraisons-mais-les-marges-sont-sous-pression-zone-bourse-313a3789eba05dc0c2cde061a57139e98f637908), so the estimates are dispersed. The FY bar is the company's own guide.
session_check: amc. Airbus's own pre-close (14 Oct) says 9M results on 28 October after market close: Zonebourse/AOF 'Les résultats des neuf premiers mois seront publiés le 28 octobre, après la clôture des marchés' (https://www.boursedirect.fr/fr/actualites/categorie/analyse-des-valeurs-qui-font-l-actualite/airbus-confirme-ses-objectifs-de-livraisons-mais-les-marges-sont-sous-pression-zone-bourse-313a3789eba05dc0c2cde061a57139e98f637908) and Quartr's pre-close summary (https://quartr.com/events/airbus-se-air-pre-close-call_3g8Qdgvx). Prior 9M, Q1 and H1 prints were also after the close. The window is 28 Oct close to 29 Oct close.
positioning_check: The AMF positions courtes nettes register was read (covered: true, as of 2026-10-22, https://www.data.gouv.fr/api/1/datasets/r/c2539d1c-8531-4937-9cba-3bd8e9786cc5). It shows no disclosed net short at or above 0.5% and no change over ten days. That is the truncation floor, not evidence that nobody is short: anchor_covered is false. Airbus SE is Dutch-registered (home regulator AFM), so the name join may also miss positions. In effect there is no positioning anchor, and priced_lean_pct (-0.09) is the run-up.

findings.finding: At its 14 Oct pre-close Airbus lowered the Q3 bar itself (under-absorption, quality, Spirit, R&D), and consensus now sits at EBIT adj EUR 1.79bn, -7% YoY. Airbus beat EPS consensus in 3 of its last 4 quarters, so a modest beat against a company-lowered bar is the more likely print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2026 beat (EPS EUR 2.84, guide held): -2.81% next session. Q1 2026 (EPS below consensus but guide held): +5.13%. 9M 2025: +2.06%. H1 2025: -1.58%. Beats are not reliably bought.
findings.original_quote: Le consensus 'Bloomberg' anticipe sur les trois mois clos fin septembre un EBIT ajusté de 1,79 milliard d'euros pour des revenus de 18,09 milliards d'euros [...] Les analystes de 'Bloomberg Intelligence' explique que l'EBIT pourrait reculer de 7,5% au troisième trimestre (Bloomberg consensus for the quarter: EBIT adj EUR 1.79bn on revenue EUR 18.09bn; BI sees EBIT down 7.5%)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the pre-close was public and the stock rose about 6.5% over 14-16 Oct on it. What is left is only the beat/miss on a bar that is now low. If a beat were fully priced, the stock would be bid well above its 194 pre-close level into the print rather than flat over five days (+0.2%).
findings.independence: Pre-close content from a different outlet: https://quartr.com/events/airbus-se-air-pre-close-call_3g8Qdgvx. EPS surprise history is in the baseline (Yahoo earningsHistory).

findings.finding: The delivery guide of ~870 is likely to be reiterated rather than cut. Wagner says every aircraft to be delivered this year is already in final assembly, UBS expects reiteration, and in 2025 Airbus cut its delivery target only in the last weeks of December, not at 9M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: June 2024 delivery/EBIT guide cut: about -11%. Feb 2026 FY guide seen as weak on deliveries: the stock fell (CNBC). The 14-15 Oct 2026 reaffirmation: +2.4% and +2.1% on consecutive sessions.
findings.original_quote: "Nous avons toutes les cartes en main ; tous les appareils que nous souhaitons livrer d'ici la fin de l'année se trouvent déjà sur la chaîne d'assemblage final." [...] ce qui l'a conduit à abaisser son objectif de livraison pour l'année à environ 790 unités dans les dernières semaines de décembre. ('We hold all the cards; every aircraft we want to deliver by year-end is already on the final assembly line.' ... last year it lowered its target to about 790 in the final weeks of December.)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced since 14 Oct. The residual is a small relief on a name still -9.4% over 60 days, where a cut at 9M is the feared tail (UBS's 'downside scenario'). If reiteration were fully priced, the 60-day drawdown would have been recovered.
findings.independence: UBS preview expecting reiteration: https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/airbus-stock-analysis-buy-setup-ahead-of-earnings-93CH-4936444. DZ Bank: Q4 +13% feasible because all aircraft are in FAL (https://www.boursedirect.fr/fr/actualites/categorie/analyse-des-valeurs-qui-font-l-actualite/airbus-confirme-ses-objectifs-de-livraisons-mais-les-marges-sont-sous-pression-zone-bourse-313a3789eba05dc0c2cde061a57139e98f637908).

findings.finding: Quality escapes this year (tools left in A330neo horizontal tails, with inspections of aircraft built 2021 to Jul 2026 and about 160 potentially affected; an A321neo anticorrosion-coating issue reported end-September) may bring a Q3 cost or provision beyond the under-absorption already flagged.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nov/Dec 2025 A320 panel issue led to a December delivery cut; no clean single-day read on a provision line.
findings.original_quote: Lars Wagner [...] s'est dit "très confiant" quant à la capacité du groupe à atteindre 870 livraisons en 2026, malgré le problème de revêtement anticorrosion de l'A321neo signalé ce week-end (Wagner 'very confident' of 870 despite the A321neo anticorrosion-coating problem reported this weekend)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the pre-close named 'quality topics' as a Q3 profitability drag, but gave no number. A discrete provision would be new money. A one-off with no path to the EBIT guide is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: A330 tail-tool inspections and the mid-November EASA policy: https://centreforaviation.com/news/airbus-to-present-full-policy-on-a330-production-flaws-to-easa-by-mid-nov-2026-1375761 ; ~160 aircraft potentially affected: https://aerospaceglobalnews.com/?p=53033

findings.finding: The pre-close said inventories stay high on undelivered widebodies and cash follows the usual seasonality, so 9M FCF before customer financing is likely still negative against a ~EUR 4.5bn FY guide, leaving a very large Q4 cash implied (H1 was -EUR 1.166bn).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2026: a -EUR 1.2bn FCF outflow alongside the beat, and the stock fell 2.81%. Cash was part of the sell-side read (aviationbusinessnews headline 'EUR 1.2bn cash shortfall').
findings.original_quote: Concernant la trésorerie, Airbus prévoit une évolution conforme à la saisonnalité habituelle, tandis que les stocks devraient rester élevés, notamment en raison des gros-porteurs restant à livrer. (On cash, Airbus expects the usual seasonality, while inventories should stay high, notably because of widebodies still to be delivered.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced, since the pre-close said it. But the sell-side previews quoted on 27 Oct focus on EBIT and give no FCF consensus, so a weak 9M cash print is the line least anchored. Shares the pre-close source with finding 1 but lands on a different line.

findings.finding: Counterparty: Safran's Q3 release (23 Oct) reported 535 LEAP deliveries in Q3 (+5% YoY; 1,565 over 9M, +26%) and confirmed its 2026 objectives, which include LEAP +16-19%. That implies a strong Q4 engine flow consistent with Airbus's Q4 delivery push (CFM supply only; Pratt remains a stated constraint).
findings.why_not_priced: Snippet only: the Safran page returned 403 to both curl and WebFetch, so the figures come from a search snippet and are not load-bearing. Public counterparty data four sessions before the print, so mostly priced. It mainly lowers the odds of a delivery cut.
findings.independence: Safran's July guide raise to LEAP +16-19%: https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/safran-releve-ses-objectifs-annuels-porte-par-ses-services-pour-moteurs-d-avion_700420

outside_window.finding: Airbus to present its full policy on A330 production flaws to EASA by mid-November 2026; a broad inspection or retrofit burden would be a cost/delivery risk
Whether ~870 deliveries is actually met is settled by December deliveries (Q4 needs 323 vs 286 in Q4 2025); in 2025 the cut came in late December
Possible German order for 16 additional A400M (EUR 150-200m each), which needs Bundestag approval

baseline_tension: The baseline has almost no lean (-0.09, run-up +1.8% over 20d, 0.0 truncated short). The findings net slightly positive (+0.1) and do not cut against it. The real tension is the 60-day -9.4% drawdown on delivery doubts, which a routine reiteration only partly relieves.
language_note: The Bloomberg consensus for Q3 (EBIT adj EUR 1.79bn, revenue EUR 18.09bn, CA EUR 12.89bn, net EUR 1.29bn) and the Bloomberg Intelligence and Deutsche Bank -7% previews came only from French Boursier.com copy dated 27 Oct; English searches returned no Q3 consensus

The detailed pre-close content (Spirit AeroSystems drag, higher R&D, inventories high on undelivered widebodies, cash seasonal) and the DZ Bank (+4% EBIT, TP 227) and Jefferies comments came from Zonebourse/AOF French copy; the English Quartr summary omitted Spirit, R&D and cash

Wagner's 'tous les appareils [...] se trouvent déjà sur la chaîne d'assemblage final' quote, with the 2025 precedent of a late-December cut, came from French Boursier copy; English sources carried only 'very confident'
The A321neo anticorrosion-coating issue reached me only through the French Zonebourse 30 Sep piece
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the reported-quarter beat finding rests on a bar the company itself lowered at the public pre-close, so it was cut from +0.6 to +0.4
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' (Luceco): the pre-close's high-inventory and seasonal-cash statement, which I had read but not filed, was filed as its own cash-flow finding at -0.3

'The move is in the guide' (reiterated, median 2.3%) and 'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction': abs_move kept at 3.5 (period partly pre-released, guide expected unchanged, but understatement is the systematic error) and p_up moved from 53 to 52 because H1's beat was sold
